finals.race: Virgin Bet Training Series Final Apprentice Handicap (Div 1)
finals.comment: Looked back to his best when ending losing run at Ayr (heavy) last month, suited by the strong pace. Shaped as though still in reasonable nick when fifth here 2 weeks ago (Feel The Need second) but does need everything to fall right.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Training Series Final Apprentice Handicap (Div 1)
finals.comment: Continued a theme of run-to-run progression when 1¼ lengths second of 8 to Lady Vega in novice at Redcar in September. Had the run of the race that day and was found out in better company on all-weather a month ago. Handicap debut from a tough-looking mark.

finals.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Beginners Chase
finals.comment: Useful hurdler but wasn't able to land short odds on chasing/seasonal debut in 2-runner maiden at Sligo (2¼m) in September. However, yard is going much better now and she remains capable of better given her hurdles form. Well worth another chance.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Training Series Final Apprentice Handicap (Div 2)
finals.comment: Capitalised on a reduced mark to end losing run in 14-runner handicap at Redcar (6f, heavy) 12 days ago, doing well to overcome a troubled passage. Back up 3 lb but this veteran can go very well again.

finals.race: Gerry Comerford Drilling Beginners Chase
finals.comment: Point winner who has shown fair form over hurdles. With hood fitted after 5 months off, mid-field in maiden at Wexford on chasing debut in June, before running below expectations over hurdles in August. However, she could well fare better at her second attempt back chasing.

finals.race: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Progressive over hurdles last season, winning 2 of his last 3 starts and shaping well on handicap bow in between. Reappears with his yard in red-hot form so needs considering on chase bow.

finals.race: Follow Matchbook On X Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Placed twice on the Flat in France and did well over hurdles last season, winning a juvenile maiden at Market Rasen. Relished the step up in trip when making a winning start over fences at Stratford on handicap bow/return 3 weeks ago, forging clear. Surely has more to offer still.

finals.race: Follow Matchbook On X Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Acquired for £72,000 after twice runner-up in Irish points. Progressed over hurdles last season, cosily off the mark at Carlisle in April. Appeals as the sort who'll take to chasing and he offered something to work on under a considerate ride when third at Perth on return. Better expected now.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Supports Safer Gambling Nursery
finals.comment: Improved model switched to nurseries, taking her record to 4 wins from 5 starts in game fashion at Catterick 11 days ago. Up further 5 lb but she's an uncomplicated sort with a good attitude.

finals.race: Bet 20 Get 40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Steadily-progressive sort who won 3 handicaps last season. Only found one on a roll too good on return at Market Rasen (23f) last month. In excellent hands and should be in the mix with another step forward.

finals.race: Bet 20 Get 40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Lost his form after completing a double at Hexham last autumn. Revitalised by blinkers/switch to front running recently, backing up his previous effort when runner-up in small-field C&D handicap. Needs a bit more in a deeper race.

finals.race: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap
finals.comment: Back to form when runner-up twice over 1m at Ayr since blinkers have gone on. Can go one better with Rhys Elliott taking a useful 5 lb off.

finals.race: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap
finals.comment: C&D winner. Placed at Ayr (1m) in July but hasn't fully fired in 2 all-weather starts back from a break this autumn.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Every Saturday Money Back Wentworth Stakes (Listed)
finals.comment: Group 3 winner at Leopardstown for Michael O'Callaghan last summer. Not reached that level in 3 runs for this stable but better signs when sixth of 19 in Sceptre Stakes here (7f, good to firm) last time, faring best of those ridden prominently. Not without interest at 6f in first-time tongue tie.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Every Saturday Money Back Wentworth Stakes (Listed)
finals.comment: Progressive sort who bagged a fourth success of the season in 6f handicap at Salisbury in September. Beaten a neck in 13-runner listed race at Newmarket (6f, good) last time. Very much one to consider.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Every Saturday Money Back Wentworth Stakes (Listed)
finals.comment: Yet another fine advert for his yard, winning 6 times on all-weather between December and March. Added to his tally in game fashion at Ascot (6f) in October and backed it up with a solid third of 15 to Advertised over C&D (heavy) 15 days ago. Possibilities.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Every Saturday Money Back Wentworth Stakes (Listed)
finals.comment: Returned with a much-improved second in Group 3 Pavilion Stakes at Ascot (6f) in May. Has failed to reproduce it however, tongue tied when only seventh of 13 in listed race at Newmarket (6f, good) 29 days ago.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Every Saturday Money Back Wentworth Stakes (Listed)
finals.comment: Frankel filly shaped well when a debut third at 2yrs and made light of a year's absence to land 5-runner novice at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in August. Tongue strap goes on for first time. Capable of better still but this requires major improvement.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Every Saturday Money Back Wentworth Stakes (Listed)
finals.comment: Useful effort when making a bold bid for a Chester double (6f) in May. Back to form in first-time cheekpieces when fourth of 13 in listed race at Newmarket (6f, good) last time. This is a tough ask though.

finals.race: Proficient Engineering Irish EBF Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Crystal Ocean. Dam (b81), lightly raced in bumpers, sister to useful hurdler/fairly useful chaser (winner up to 3¼m) Cup Final and fairly useful hurdler/useful chaser (stayed 2½m) Asta La Pasta. Easy winner of second start in points (Apr 2026). Interesting hurdling debutant for a good yard.

finals.race: Matchbook Loves Racing Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Dual hurdles winner who bettered that form over fences last season, winning first 2 starts and runner up all 4 starts thereafter, edged out close home at Market Rasen (21f) when last seen in April. Record fresh very much a positive as she returns with yard in top form.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Foaled April 7. $250,000 yearling, €350,000 2-y-o, Flightline colt. Dam once-raced half-sister to winner up to 1m Fort Myers and 1m winner Dublin (both useful) out of Irish 1000 Guineas winner Marvellous. Plenty of appeal on paper and yard has very strong 2-y-o squad.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Foaled February 23. €58,000 yearling, resold €95,000 yearling, Sioux Nation colt. Closely related to 7f/1m winner Kaleidoscope Eyes, and half-brother to 3 winners, including 1m winner Alibaba and Australian 1½m winner Fantasising. One of 2 interesting debutants for the yard.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Foaled March 28. €90,000 foal, 175,000 gns yearling, St Mark's Basilica colt. Dam, 9f/1¼m winner, half-sister to useful winner up to 1¼m (stays 1½m) Elizabeth Jane out of very smart 1m-1½m winner Sapphire, herself half-sister to top-class stayer Kyprios. Plenty of stamina in his pedigree.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Showed plenty of ability when second of 11 over 1m on debut at Salisbury in September but went backwards for no obvious reason at Goodwood (9f) next time. Could be more one for next year.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Foaled February 26. 80,000 gns yearling, €180,000 2-y-o, Baaeed colt. Half-brother to several winners, including winner up to 6f Miramar and winner up to 9f The Rosstafarian, both useful. Dam French 7f winner. One of 2 intriguing newcomers for top stable.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Irish EBF Gillies Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
finals.comment: Won novices first 2 starts and improved again when runner-up in Musidora at York. Similar form in defeat last 2 starts, including when 6½ lengths fourth of 14 in Group 3 at Newmarket 4 weeks ago, meeting some trouble. Should be thereabouts once more if handling conditions (dam won on soft).

finals.race: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Irish EBF Gillies Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
finals.comment: Useful filly but without a win since her debut, runner-up 5 times at this level before snatching defeat from the jaws of victory in a Group 3 at Milan 3 weeks ago (collared close home after idling markedly).

finals.race: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Irish EBF Gillies Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
finals.comment: Well-bred daughter of Dubawi who confirmed debut promise from last autumn when landing the odds in good style after 12 months off at Kempton 26 days ago. This is a big step up but she remains totally unexposed.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Irish EBF Gillies Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
finals.comment: 1,600,000 gns filly who left debut run behind 7 months on when winning Wolverhampton novice with plenty in hand. Better form since but left behind by Felicitas at Sandown next time and only seventh when tried at this level back from 4 months off at Longchamp. Back down in trip and headgear goes on.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Irish EBF Gillies Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
finals.comment: Half-sister to top-class winner up to 1½m City of Troy who made most of good opportunity in maiden at the Curragh last month. However, was unable to find the necessary improvement when tried at this level there last week.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Irish EBF Gillies Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
finals.comment: Bounced back to her best to capitalise on the drop in grade in good style at Salisbury but was beaten almost 8 lengths back at this level at Saint-Cloud 5 weeks ago.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Irish EBF Gillies Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
finals.comment: Placed at listed/Group 3 level last year but failed to progress in early part of this season and has acted as a pacemaker this summer. Trip too far at Naas (1½m) latest.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Irish EBF Gillies Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
finals.comment: Made a winning debut at Southwell a year ago and confirmed that promise at the second attempt when third (behind Felicitas) in the Musidora at York. Most disappointing 3 starts since, however (tried in headgear latest).

finals.race: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Irish EBF Gillies Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
finals.comment: Made a belated winning return in a maiden at Cork in August but has struggled at a higher level both starts since. Headgear goes on.

finals.race: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Debut bumper winner (beat Zeus Power) who typically found plenty for pressure to land a hat-trick at Worcester (2½m). Again advanced his form in spite of his jumping when third in a strong Silver Trophy (19f) last time. Type who should relish 3m and appeals with race-fitness on his side.

finals.race: 0% Commission For 110 Days At Matchbook Mares' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Modest winner on the Flat this summer. Runner-up (clear of a last-time-out winner) in a solid novice handicap at Southwell (2½m) last month. Saw off a couple of relatively promising types to go one better at Huntingdon (21f) 6 days ago. Probably needs to progress again to defy a 7-lb penalty.

finals.race: Midnite Building The Future Of Betting Handicap
finals.comment: Failed to go on for Jane Chapple-Hyam and even the excellent James Owen yard hasn't managed to conjure a big run out of her yet. A first-time visor needs to help.

finals.race: Virgin Bet November Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Won this on heavy 2 years ago. Creditable sixth to Castle Cove 12 months ago. Warmed up for this year's renewal with a good third of 18 at York (10.3f, soft) 4 weeks ago. Looks primed for another big run in this race.

finals.race: Virgin Bet November Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Progressive sort who made it 4-6 in handicaps when seeing off 4 rivals at Leicester ((1½m, good to firm) on last month's turf debut. Going softer than good an unknown but he's likely capable of better again.

finals.race: Virgin Bet November Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Reacted well to cheekpieces with back-to-back wins over 1½m on soft at Epsom and Goodwood this summer. Never involved in a listed race at Chester last time but this is more his thing. Toby Moore takes 7 lb off.

finals.race: Virgin Bet November Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Made a winning return over C&D in April and ran up to her best having a first crack at 2m when 4 lengths second of 4 to Kirchner at Ascot (2m, good to firm) in July. Off 106 days.

finals.race: Play Lucky Stable With William Hill Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Back on track following a breathing operation, doubling his chase tally over C&D in May. Rarely finds much but in line with yard's good form, returned from 5 months off with a career-best second at Ffos Las (soft) 24 days ago. Just the type to go well again around here back on a sounder surface.

finals.race: Play Lucky Stable With William Hill Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Smart chaser with excellent strike rate for Willie Mullins. Didn't kick on from an eye-catching yard debut fourth at Doncaster next 2 starts back in the spring but looked to finish with running left when fifth of 7 in handicap at Newton Abbot (21f) when last seen 6 months ago. Not one to write off.

finals.race: Download The Matchbook App Mares' Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Vadamos filly. Dam, 2m-2¼m hurdle/chase winner, half-sister to winning hurdler/chaser up to 2½m Sorcier du Roi out of useful hurdle/chase winner up to 2½m Knock Down. Easy winner of an Irish point in May and she commands respect with yard in excellent form.

finals.race: Download The Matchbook App Mares' Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Passing Glance filly. Sister to 3 winners, including useful bumper winner/very smart hurdler Strong Leader (2m-25f winner) and bumper winner/fairly useful hurdler Strong Glance (2m-19f winner). Makes plenty of appeal on paper.

finals.race: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back EBF 'Confined' Restricted Maiden Stakes
finals.comment: 11/1, held back by inexperience when fifth of 11 in novice at Kempton (7f) on debut 26 days ago. In the right hands to progress.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Daily Extra Places Handicap
finals.comment: Doubled his tally for the year at Pontefract (6f) in October and followed up in cosy fashion at Catterick (7f). Under a penalty, ran at least as well in defeat when second of 15 over this C&D 15 days ago and he enters calculations.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Daily Extra Places Handicap
finals.comment: With headgear discarded, got off the mark for the campaign at Beverley (5f) in September and took another step forward when following up in clear-cut fashion at Pontefract 19 days ago. Up in grade but he's thriving ahead of first 6f start of the year.

finals.race: Virgin Bet Daily Extra Places Handicap
finals.comment: Wasn't seen to best effect in the Ayr Bronze Cup and wasted no time getting back on the up when scoring at Haydock (7f) in September. Followed up at Ripon (6f) only the next day and soon left behind a lesser effort at York when runner-up at this course (7f) 15 days ago.

dropped.race: Virgin Bet Training Series Final Apprentice Handicap (Div 1)
dropped.comment: Continued a theme of run-to-run progression when 1¼ lengths second of 8 to Lady Vega in novice at Redcar in September. Had the run of the race that day and was found out in better company on all-weather a month ago. Handicap debut from a tough-looking mark.
